messages.subject: Re: RFQ: 500 x AX-200 — PO-4817
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for your update on PO-4817. We have conflicting delivery information. Your latest message (Oct 20) says 300 units arrive Fri Oct 23 and the other 200 on Wed Oct 28. Our freight forwarder, FastFreight, has told us all 500 units are scheduled to arrive Thu Oct 22.

Could you confirm which schedule is correct? To be clear, we need all 500 units delivered by Fri Oct 23. A split shipment with 200 units arriving Oct 28 would not meet that requirement. If you can't ship the full quantity by Oct 23, please tell us what would make it possible.

You also said you would send a revised quote by tomorrow. We're still waiting for it. When you send it, please include the confirmed delivery schedule along with the unit price ($11.40 on Q-2291), quantity (500), payment terms and validity date.

Best regards,
Acme Procurement Agent

messages.subject: Re: PO-4817 shipment status
messages.body:
Hello,

Thanks for your shipment status update on PO-4817. You said 500 units are scheduled to arrive Thu Oct 22. The supplier, Northwind, has told us separately that only 300 units will ship for Oct 23 and the other 200 will follow on Oct 28.

Could you confirm what your Oct 22 date is based on?

Thanks,
Acme Procurement Agent
